description:
WebNN is not shipped without flags (desktop Chrome 153 reports "WebNN is not supported in current environment" outside the flag; Android/iOS WebViews won't have it), so the local-MVP gate as written is dead. Switch the neural compute API to WebGPU via the ONNX Runtime Web WebGPU EP (WASM for tiny graphs and as the reference).

Scope:
- plan.md: WebGPU replaces WebNN (compute strategy, runtime interfaces, Phase 0 steps, acceptance criteria, risk). iOS moves from reserved/QoL into scope: supported hosts are the Even app WebView on Android and iOS, plus standalone Chrome (Android) and Safari (iOS 26+) for development and testing.
- Probe harness: EPs become webgpu / wasm; capabilities probe inventories navigator.gpu (main + worker), adapter info, features (shader-f16, timestamp-query), limits (maxBufferSize, maxStorageBufferBindingSize), a known-answer compute shader and matmul timing; bench worker captures ORT node placement (WebGPU EP vs CPU fallback); Safari-safe feature detection.
- HTTPS dev serving so phone Chrome/Safari get a secure context (WebGPU, OPFS, COOP/COEP need it).
- RUNBOOK: WebGPU pass/fail criteria; Android Chrome, iOS Safari, and Even app (Android + iOS) runs.
- Registry/scripts/tickets: drop WebNN-specific notes and titles.
- Verify on desktop Chrome with a real WebGPU benchmark run.
title: Switch local inference from WebNN to WebGPU; support Android Chrome and iOS Safari
